_comment: MCP policy for the dev agent. servers feeds loadMcpServers (server-level filtering, all it can do). allowedTools feeds the PreToolUse hook as mcpToolAllowlist, which denies any other mcp__* tool (screenshot, debug_*, device, UI) even though the whole server is loaded, since server-name filtering alone cannot drop individual tools. Only the build/test tools the TDD loop needs are listed; the authoritative build gate stays parent-owned.
